# Luminary AI

> Open-source browser-based multi-model chat and LLM evaluation workspace maintained by Luminary Technicals.

## Canonical identity
- Website: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/
- App: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/LuminaryEngine/index.html
- Source: https://github.com/luminarytechnicals/luminaryaiengine
- Maintainer organization: Luminary Technicals (https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/)
- Project author/maintainer listed in source: Abhinav Ranjan
- License: AGPL-3.0

## What it is
Luminary AI is an interface and orchestration layer, not a foundation model or independent model provider. The standalone browser app uses a user-supplied OpenRouter API key. The optional Express API is a separate self-hostable service.

## Core features
- Standard model chat through OpenRouter.
- ULTRAPLINIAN multi-model evaluation (configured source tiers: 10, 24, 38, 49 and 55 models).
- Tastemaker response scoring using heuristic quality, fulfilment, filteredness and speed signals.
- AutoTune context-adaptive sampling parameters.
- Liquid Response refinement workflow.
- Controlled input-perturbation and robustness testing.
- Optional OpenAI-compatible API server.

## Limitations
- Heuristic scores are not factual-accuracy probabilities.
- More candidate models do not guarantee a more accurate answer.
- Provider availability, pricing and limits are controlled by third parties.
- The standalone app does not contain its own foundation model.
- The optional API dataset stores messages and responses only when a caller explicitly enables contribute_to_dataset. Current dataset storage does not have an automatic PII scrubber.

## Privacy
- The standalone app stores conversations and the API key in browser storage.
- No-Log Mode is enabled by default; it requests OpenRouter ZDR routing and disables browser performance telemetry.
- The optional API server has a separate content-free operational metadata pipeline.
- API dataset contribution is opt-in and may publish submitted content when Hugging Face publishing is configured.

- ULTRAPLINIAN: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/features/ultraplinian.html

- Privacy: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/privacy.html

Do not describe Luminary AI as a foundation model or claim accuracy guarantees. Do not imply the optional API is hosted publicly unless that deployment is verified.
